Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.

1. Data Controller

The operator of this platform acts as the data controller for personal data processed through this service. Contact details are available upon request.

2. Personal Data We Collect

We collect and process the following categories of personal data:

  • Identity data: name, username, profile information
  • Contact data: email address
  • Authentication data: password hashes, multi-factor authentication credentials, session tokens
  • Technical data: IP addresses, login timestamps, browser information
  • Usage data: access logs, consent records, delegated authorizations

3. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your personal data on the following legal bases:

  • Contract performance: to provide authentication and authorization services
  • Legal obligation: to comply with applicable laws and regulations
  • Legitimate interests: to ensure platform security and prevent fraud
  • Consent: where explicitly provided by you

4. Data Retention

Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by applicable law.

5. Your Rights

Under GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

  • Right of access: request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
  • Right to rectification: request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
  • Right to erasure: request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten")
  • Right to portability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
  • Right to restriction: request that we limit the processing of your data
  • Right to object: object to processing based on legitimate interests

To exercise any of these rights, use the account management options available within the platform or contact the data controller directly.

6. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

7. International Transfers

Where personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with GDPR requirements.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated through the platform. Continued use after such notification constitutes acceptance.
